about_short_description.short_description: Intelmatix is a deep-tech AI company with capabilities that address sector challenges by providing tailored solutions and unique products.

product.name: EDIX Platform
product.description: An enterprise AI platform that acts as the digital brain of organizations, integrating AI agents to analyze data, forecast scenarios, recommend decisions, and coordinate actions.

product.name: EDIX Suites
product.description: Sector-specific bundles of AI agents tailored to address the unique logic, data, and workflows of various industries.

product.name: EDIX Retail Suite
product.description: AI agents focused on optimizing pricing, inventory, operations, customer insights, and store scheduling within retail organizations.

product.name: EDIX Talent Suite
product.description: AI agents designed to support workforce planning, HR analytics, skills alignment, and compliance management.

product.name: EDIX Cities Suite
product.description: AI agents that manage urban services such as mobility, energy, waste, and citizen experience coordination across city departments.

product.name: EDIX Logistics Suite
product.description: AI agents that optimize fleet routing, demand prediction, delivery orchestration, and warehouse operations for logistics management.
